opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 for research... In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools/FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees/projects, or organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases considered).
opportunities.summary: Research funding for projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions from its Strategic Review, to improve lives in the UK. Assessed on relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience and value for money. Two application rounds per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK applicants; applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: 'Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK'. Funds research on racial inequalities, discrimination, disadvantage and pathways towards a UK reaping the benefits of its racial diversity. One deadline per year (Autumn).
